dedupe_keys.name: tool to assess resource adequacy tara

description: Tool to Assess Resource Adequacy (TARA) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Institute for High Voltage Equipment and Grids; Digitalization and Energy Economics (IAEW) at RWTH Aachen University. The model determines the optimal dispatch of available capacities in each bidding zone of the interconnected European power system. In addition to deterministic electricity market analyses, the model can be applied within a probabilistic framework to assess resource adequacy. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Market Simulation, Resource Adequacy. Time resolution: hour, 15 min. Software: C++. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
